mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in total demand (GDPC1) over the past 3 months predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in expansionary demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE crosses above 5.5% but 20-day forward returns are positive, or the crossing occurs without a subsequent rally within 5 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both total demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) over the past month predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase over the past month, yet 60-day forward returns are negative, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) during a tightening cycle predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS is in a tightening cycle (increasing for 3 months) but 20-day forward returns are positive, or the tightening is not sustained beyond 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in supply (INDPRO below 105) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains below 105 for 3 months but 60-day forward returns are positive, or the contraction is not persistent.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of employment (PAYEMS) above 140,000 predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS crosses above 140000 but 20-day forward returns are negative, or the crossing occurs without a subsequent rally within 5 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained period with unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE stays below 4.5% for 3 months but 5-day forward returns are negative, or the regime condition is not met consistently.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both total demand (GDPC1) and demand for housing (HOUST) over the past month predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Both GDPC1 and HOUST increase over the past month, yet 20-day forward returns are negative, or the combined effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
